reuse_check.why_not_equivalent: It compares the bound full sort to independently trained exact-lattice window sort SHA 901de0..., not the requested rounded-kriging window sort SHA e82b040....

requested_h5_support.search_first: Reuse any completed audit that binds both exact sort hashes; do not repeat scoring, plots, overlap, or bootstrap.
requested_h5_support.allowed: Read only execution metadata, frozen source/config snapshots, receipts, and tiny saved arrays or derived hashes needed for equivalence.
return: Authoritative paths and SHA-256 bindings for both sort outputs and their run contracts/receipts.
Common W3 sampling rate, half-open global frame interval, recording/crop origin, and each run's local-to-global frame transform.

Motion-field path/hash; field value/frame semantics; interpolation, sign, border/support, and rounding rules; plus a hash comparison of q/displacement and mapping/support IDs at identical W3 global frames (boundaries, seams, and interior).
Physical channel IDs/order/count, geometry hash, excluded sites, crop/support, and materialized dtype for each run.
Executed preprocessing sequence and exact boundary of motion correction, including filtering, phase shift, reference, centering, whitening/covariance, with frozen source hashes and versions.
Executed DARTsort/SpikeInterface versions and effective sorter parameters, seed, training sampling/context, template/detection/matching/clustering settings, and any caps/defaults.
Checkpoint/cache lineage: confirm whether the full matching checkpoint and window intermediates were generated from their claimed contracts and whether stale or cross-arm state could enter.
A concise confirmed-differences versus missing-provenance table. Classify intended training/population differences separately from unintended implementation/input mismatches.
do_not: rescore, plot, bootstrap, or perform RF/holdout work

frozen_candidate_fixture.candidate: global-frame motion/preprocessing equivalence across the common W3 interval
frozen_candidate_fixture.prediction: If both runs implement the same rounded-kriging input pipeline, identical global W3 frames must have identical field lookup values, interpolation/mapping support, physical geometry/order, and preprocessing boundary; only training duration/sampling and resulting learned population may differ.
frozen_candidate_fixture.cheapest_test: Compare saved effective metadata and hashes, then independently materialize only q/displacement and mapping/support identifiers at boundary, seam-adjacent, and deterministic interior frames from saved field/config artifacts; no voltage.
frozen_candidate_fixture.accept_candidate: Any reproducible mismatch in time-origin transform, field hash/rounding/sign/interpolation, geometry/order/support, preprocessing order/boundary, effective sorter parameters, or checkpoint lineage that is not an explicitly intended training-context difference.
frozen_candidate_fixture.stop_no_candidate: Exact agreement on these invariants, with only full-session versus W3 training/population context remaining; classify the rho contrast as unresolved and do not promote a medium experiment from it.
